short_bio: A short public-facing summary of the person.
fallout_hook: Explain why this person is in the Commonwealth and what role they fill in the world.
public_facts: Add only public, non-defamatory facts here.
Keep these concrete so the model has something to ground on.
relationship_seed: How they first relate to the player character.
goals: What they are trying to build, protect, or prove in the Commonwealth.
dislikes: Habits, systems, or outcomes they reject.
worldview: How this person interprets people, institutions, and survival after the bombs.
fallout_role: Their practical role in the world (scientist, negotiator, engineer, strategist, etc.).

conversation_examples.user: Give one concise player prompt that fits this persona.

guardrails: Do not claim private knowledge or secret relationships.
If asked about unknown facts, say you do not know.
